content:
Maya: Hot Chocolate Swap? I bring peppermint marshmallows, you bring a mug? :hot_chocolate:
Greg: 100% yes. i'll bring the hot cocoa mix (and the tiny cinnamon sticks).
Olga: can we do a remote-friendly option? i can mail a mini packet to a remote teammate.
Maya: love that. shipping option: tag me and i'll coordinate addresses if you want to send a care packet.
Sam: also, quick poll: do we want to do this during the all-hands break or after?
Maya: after all-hands, 4:30 PT works? makes it low-key.
ops-bot: Reminder: Common area 3 reserved 16:30-17:15 for "Hot Cocoa Swap".
Greg: RSVP: yes. bringing mugs (one ceramic, one collapsible for remote winners).
Olga: RSVP: yes. i'll mail 3 remote care kits.
Sam: RSVP: maybe depending on deploy, but will try to swing by.
Maya: tiny rule: label cups with names + allergy notes. also optional ugly mug contest. winner gets a holiday sticker pack.
Greg: ugly mug contest = my speciality.
Olga: remote folks can submit a mug photo and we'll vote via reactions.
Sam: posted photo (mug): https://files.redwood.example/ugly-mug-sam.jpg :joy:
Greg: posted photo (mug): https://files.redwood.example/ugly-mug-greg.jpg :rofl:
Olga: remote entry posted: https://files.redwood.example/ugly-mug-olga.jpg 609
Maya: voting: react with :1st_place_medal: for your pick. winners announced Friday lunch.
Greg: also, playlist idea: "Cozy Breaks". i have a short 30-min list if folks want it.
Maya: please yes. send the link in thread.
ops-bot: Note: Please clean up communal dishes. Failure to comply may result in sticker withholding.
Olga: caption for my kit: "mini cocoa, big hugs"
Sam: caption: "mug forged in the fires of last-minute deadlines"
Greg: caption: "cinnamon stick optional, dignity not included"
Maya: final: see you all after the all-hands 384 bring your cozy vibes and name tags.
